headings.instruction: Use Playfair Display for all headings to evoke luxury and corporate authority. Ensure tight tracking on large headings.

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain precision, clarity, and a modern corporate feel.

colors.primary_description: Subtle Gold / Brass for luxury accents.
colors.background_description: Deepest void black for the main background.
colors.surface_description: Slightly elevated dark surface for cards and sections.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows to separate dark elements, avoiding harsh outlines.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic gradients. Use subtle radial glows (e.g., from-white/5 to-transparent) to highlight key areas.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with a 1px border-white/10 for sticky headers. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 to let content breathe.
layouts.grids: Use bento grid protocol. Mode A (The 'Tetris' Grid) for feature sections with wide gaps (gap-8).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text. Asymmetry creates tension and luxury.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) with ease-out timing. DO NOT apply transition: all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade and slide up for list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for body text. Use off-white text against deep black.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings using primary color (focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or subtle radii (rounded-sm). Use borders and hover states that imply premium tactile feedback.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism on standard cards. 1px crisp borders.

media.style: Dark, moody, professional, high-quality photography. No generic blurred backgrounds. Each photo must have a clear, crisp subject.
media.overlays: Use bg-black/50 or bg-black/40 overlay on images to ensure text readability.

3d_libraries.instruction: Use Framer Motion 3D or TSParticles if atmospheric motion is needed, keeping it subtle for a corporate luxury aesthetic.

dept_equity.description: Dark stock exchange / trading floor with glowing market screens, or a sharp dark photo of financial district towers at dusk.

dept_realassets.description: Dark construction site with tower cranes at night, or brutalist concrete structure.

dept_ip.description: Dark macro of circuit board / server room with depth / laboratory glass.

dept_credit.description: Dark luxury bank interior, vault door, or marble-and-brass financial hall.

strategy_identify.description: Dark city viewed from above at night with sharp lights (aerial), conveying global scanning.

strategy_structure.description: Dark geometric concrete architecture / columns / sharp angles.

strategy_hold.description: Long-exposure dark city or a single timeless tower against moving clouds.

home_band.description: Ultra-wide dark skyline panorama at dusk, sharp, cinematic, no readable signage.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a luxury corporate website. Avoid generic layouts.
Prioritize deep blacks and crisp typography.
Ensure images are implemented exactly as specified with dark overlays if text sits on top.
Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the moody, professional aesthetic.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components and files in .js (.jsx syntax is fine, but file extension should be .js).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect human natural reading flow.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g. 🤖, 💡, etc.) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have content under them.
